props.caption: CoreWeave’s contracted demand reaches the grid before it reaches an energized rack.

items.note: A 396-page criminal judgment has one defendant in custody and two beyond the court’s reach.
The presidency centralized a national toll of 181 dead while local inventories continued to move.
Japan’s H3 placed Michibiki-7 into its planned transfer orbit after the launcher’s December failure.
Police confirmed 14 illegal miners dead after a disused platinum-dump excavation collapsed.
Presidential assent made intentional disruption of Vande Mataram a criminal offence.
Police began enforcing helmet and visibility rules for privately owned electric scooters.

items.kicker: Japan Puts Michibiki Back on the H3
items.what: JAXA’s H3 Flight No. 9 placed the Michibiki-7 navigation satellite into its planned transfer orbit. The success follows the December loss of Michibiki-5 and advances Japan’s regional positioning constellation; the remaining test is on-orbit commissioning, not liftoff.

items.kicker: Vietnam Books a Seat Before Building the Satellite
items.what: Vingroup’s VinSpace signed a SpaceX Transporter rideshare contract for its first spacecraft in 2027. The company disclosed no price, satellite count or payload specification, leaving a launch reservation where a programme scale would normally sit.

items.kicker: Rustenburg’s Dump Collapses on Fourteen Miners
items.what: South African police confirmed 14 illegal miners dead and at least eight injured after an excavation collapsed at a disused platinum-group-metals dump near Rustenburg. Search work continued, so the confirmed toll is an operating count rather than a final roster.

items.kicker: India Gives Vande Mataram a Criminal Boundary
items.what: President Droupadi Murmu assented to an amendment punishing intentional disruption of the national song with as much as three years in prison or a fine. The law targets disruption; it does not impose a general duty to sing.

items.kicker: The Philippines Keeps Two Storm Ledgers
items.what: Philippine agencies reported different casualty totals from cyclones Luis and Maymay plus the southwest monsoon, with police reaching 26 while the disaster council’s validated count remained lower. Landslides, drowning and electrocution drove the gap; neither list was final.

items.kicker: The Po Sends Tankers to Town
items.what: Po River flows fell toward one-third of seasonal levels at several stations while pre-Alpine lakes reached extreme lows. More than 100 municipalities relied on tanker water, turning a basin statistic into a municipal delivery schedule.

items.kicker: Paris Puts a Helmet on the Private Scooter
items.what: Paris police began targeted enforcement of helmet and high-visibility requirements for privately owned electric scooters. Rental scooters have been banned since 2023; the new fines move the remaining safety burden onto private riders.
